contracts.inputs: Fixed published mathematical puzzles and prescribed positive composites, all odd nonsquares greater than two.
contracts.root_only: gcd(N,J), gcd(N,J+1), J=floor(sqrt(N)); no residual is read.
contracts.residual_only: gcd(N,R), gcd(N,A) given their materialized values; no root coordinate is read.
contracts.complete_residual: Computing those residuals from N incurs the target root and exact squares, included in its timer.
contracts.prime_support_equivalence: gcd(N,R)=gcd(N,J^2) and gcd(N,A)=gcd(N,(J+1)^2); shared-prime supports agree with the corresponding root gcd. For squarefree N the gcd values also agree.
contracts.fixed_gap_U: For b>=1 and a^2=mN+b^2, the condition a>b^2 puts the witness in U. No new fixed-gap public witness call was made.
contracts.lower_family: q=a^2*p+delta, 1<=delta<=2a gives J=ap,R=delta*p; D for delta<=a, U otherwise.
contracts.upper_family: q=a^2*p-delta, 1<=delta<=2a-1 gives ceil root ap,A=delta*p; U for delta<a, D otherwise.
contracts.family_factor_condition: p>1 and q>a give 1<gcd(N,ap)<N; for prime q>a this gcd equals p.
contracts.novelty: Composition of classical gcd/root identities with the separated BRC state records; no general new factoring theorem claimed.

cost_contract.timed: Both gcds and verification of every returned proper factor by divmod and exact product; complete paths also pay for their root/state preparation.
cost_contract.prepared_scope: Previously materialized J or R,A is supplied; preparation is not free for an N-only caller.
cost_contract.excluded: Imports, source/input checks, fixture construction, annotation, warmup and serialization.
cost_contract.sampling: Same-process paired cost replays; not independent factoring observations.
cost_contract.positive_scope: All large fixtures are constructed composites with no prime-factor claim; four specified small pairs receive exact bounded primality checks.

reuse_resolution: COMPOSE_APPLIED: pinned native floor-root source, saved BRC states, standard-library gcd, and the earlier bounded small-prime checker.

residue_pair_extension.domain: N is odd and nonsquare, N>2; R=N-J^2, A=(J+1)^2-N. A prepared positive pair satisfies A-R=3 mod 4.
residue_pair_extension.scope: Exact gcd values, including nonsquare composites with repeated prime factors; no squarefree premise is needed.
residue_pair_extension.information_scope: Both residuals are retained. They encode J=(R+A-1)/2, so avoiding the root coordinate in the gcd is not an information-loss claim.
residue_pair_extension.candidate_operands: Only R,A and their neighboring integers; approximately half the bit length of N.

cost_contract.timed: Domain checks, gcds, parity correction, factor divmod/product verification and equality checks. Complete pair calls include target root and residual construction.
cost_contract.excluded: Imports, source/input checks, fixture restoration, warmups and serialization.
cost_contract.comparison: New paired same-process run; compare to its own baseline, not prior-run timing.

residue_pair_extension.extension_scope: A separate exact-identity and cost extension on the saved corpus. Original endpoint observations and timings are unchanged.

centered_union_extension.sign: D gives positive delta; U gives negative delta; odd N excludes delta=0.
centered_union_extension.union_identity: gcd(N,delta)=gcd(N,J)*gcd(N,J+1), because consecutive roots are coprime.
centered_union_extension.properness: For odd nonsquare N>2, 0<abs(delta)<=J<N, so a union value greater than one is a proper factor.
centered_union_extension.input_scope: Fixed verified odd nonsquare inputs. Complete paths include their own native root and necessary coordinate construction.

cost_contract.raw_unit: Total nanoseconds for all repeats of one variant in that round.
cost_contract.timed: Candidate calculation, proper-factor divmod/product verification and equality assertion; complete paths include root/coordinate preparation.
cost_contract.excluded: Imports, source/input/domain verification, case restoration, initial identity/warmup calls and serialization.
cost_contract.comparison: One scalar endpoint-union output for every variant, in a new paired run; earlier timing records are unchanged.
cost_contract.prepared_inputs: J, delta or (R,A) is already materialized as specified. Prepared costs are not full N-only costs.

centered_union_extension.extension_scope: New algebraic composition and cost comparison on existing fixed observations; no new public search.

center_candidate_extension.candidate: h=abs(J*(J+1)-N)>1; accept h if J mod h is 0 or h-1.
center_candidate_extension.proof: h divides J*(J+1)-N. The short remainder condition makes h divide J or J+1, hence h divides N. Also h<=J<N.
center_candidate_extension.residual_form: h=abs(A-R-1)/2 and R mod h equals J mod h; the same gate uses only the two residuals.
center_candidate_extension.scope: A sufficient subset of the centered-gcd route, not an equivalent replacement. Sentinel 1 means this candidate was not admitted; it does not assert gcd(N,h)=1 on arbitrary inputs.
center_candidate_extension.general_positive_family: For any odd p>1 and integer a>=2, q=a^2*p plus or minus (a-1) or (a+1) gives the four separated branches, abs(delta)=p and a passing short remainder.

cost_contract.raw_unit: Total nanoseconds for all repeats in a round.
cost_contract.timed: Coordinate construction required by the named input form, short remainder or gcd, candidate divmod/product verification and equality assertion; complete paths include the root.
cost_contract.excluded: Imports, source/input/domain checks, case restoration, initial identity/warmup calls, generalization controls and serialization.
cost_contract.comparison: New paired run on the same fixed corpus; candidate and centered-gcd outcomes coincide on this corpus only.
cost_contract.prepared_inputs: prepared_center_gcd receives h; prepared_root_candidate receives J and constructs h inside the timer; prepared_residual_candidate receives R,A and constructs h inside the timer.

center_candidate_extension.extension_scope: One sufficient arithmetic branch and prescribed positive generalization; no new public search or success-rate estimate.
